def top(frame):
    out={}
    for i in range(28,44):
        row=frame.ascii.split('\n')[i]
        out[i]=[(j,c) for j,c in enumerate(row[:60]) if c!='B']
    return out
def tippos(frame):
    for i in range(64):
        for j,c in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')[i]):
            if c=='r' and not (i in (30,31,32) and 51<=j<=53): return (i,j)
for (r,c,tag) in [(57,58,'N-right'),(57,50,'N-left'),(57,43,'Y-right'),(57,35,'Y-left')]:
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ch=[i for i in range(64) if previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')[i]!=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[i]]
    print(tag,'changed',res['board_changed'],ch)
    if ch and not (len(ch)==1 and ch[0]==63):
        b=top(previous_frame); a=top(current_frame)
        for i in range(28,44):
            if b[i]!=a[i]: print(i,'B:',b[i]); print(i,'A:',a[i])
        print('tip',tippos(current_frame))
        break
</parameter>
</function>
